name: Why should I insulate and drywall my garage walls?

mainEntity.name: Why should I insulate and drywall my garage walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Insulating and finishing garage walls is highly beneficial for Front Range homes due to wide seasonal temperature swings between winter and summer. Uninsulated garages allow freezing air to penetrate shared interior walls, driving up heating bills in adjacent rooms. Adding proper insulation behind newly taped and painted drywall keeps the garage warmer in the winter, moderates summer heat, and creates a clean, dust-free environment for vehicles, gear, and laundry appliances. It also provides sound dampening against street and driveway noise.
acceptedAnswer.description: Insulation and drywall moderate extreme Colorado seasonal temperatures, lower heating loss into adjacent rooms, reduce street noise, and create a clean, dust-free space.
